verdict.rationale: Exporting scenes to open formats is a fair question for a 3D engine, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers loading and importing formats (glTF, OBJ, STL, .babylon) and DCC exporter plugins that export from 3ds Max, Maya and Blender into Babylon. Nothing documents exporting a user's scenes or data out of Babylon.js in open formats, and the Apache-2.0 licence is adjacent openness, not data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
